name: Shelly Presence Gen4
summary: USB-C mmWave (60 GHz) presence sensor with zones, multi-person tracking, lux; Wi-Fi/Zigbee/Matter.

extra.coverage: wall 140°H/120°V 8x8 m; corner 90° 7x7 m; up to 42 m²
extra.people_count_conflict: spec table: up to 6 objects; main features: up to 10 people
extra.matter_zones: only 1 zone exposed by default; extra zones added as components

gotchas: Needs continuous USB-C power from a dedicated stable 5 V adapter — KB warns multi-port/fast chargers can damage it
Still (seated/sleeping) detection only out to 3 m; full 8x8 m coverage is for movement
Can't see behind itself or through walls/obstructions; placement and tilt matter
Spec says 6 tracked objects, marketing says 10 people — plan for 6
Matter exposes only one zone by default
best_for: Offices/bedrooms/living rooms where occupants sit still
